Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent made a critical error in Step 2 by misinterpreting the search results for "Otrag." While the search results clearly indicated that the entity "OTRAG" (Orbital Transport- und Raketen-Aktiengesellschaft) was a German company, the agent incorrectly concluded that the country was the "Democratic Republic of the Congo (formerly Zaire)." This conclusion was not supported by any of the visible search results, which consistently pointed to Germany. This error led to an incorrect initial assessment of the entity's location, causing unnecessary confusion and redundant search steps in subsequent turns.
